subject.title: improve: explain Windows node tool failures with telemetry

question: Should Windows node tool telemetry become the maintained operator-facing trace and metric contract with the span names and finite attributes introduced by this PR?
rationale: The patch establishes new externally exported observability semantics across gateway and MCP execution paths; tests can preserve the implementation but cannot decide the long-term contract and privacy boundary.

options.title: Approve the node-tool telemetry contract
options.body: Accept the documented spans, metrics, and finite diagnostic attributes after reviewing the redacted collector proof.

options.title: Narrow the exported contract first
options.body: Require a smaller or differently named attribute set before treating the telemetry surface as supported operator diagnostics.

recommendation.title: Approve the node-tool telemetry contract
recommendation.body: Accept the documented spans, metrics, and finite diagnostic attributes after reviewing the redacted collector proof.
